plip.preparation: Deposited PDB file; --nofix --nofixfile; default Open Babel hydrogen addition

prolif.preparation: Receptor: polymer chains of the deposited PDB file, protonated by Open Babel at pH 7.4. Ligand: deposited heavy atoms (first conformer), bond orders from the RCSB CCD canonical SMILES template or Open Babel perception, RDKit-added hydrogens. Ions as single charged atoms. No waters.
